text:

          HUISHENG INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LIMITED
                             (Incorporated in the Cayman Islands with limited liability)
                                              (Stock Code: 1340)


                   VERY SUBSTANTIAL ACQUISITION
     IN RELATION TO THE ACQUISITION OF 100% EQUITY INTEREST IN
        SHANGHAI JINGGUAN INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

                                  Financial Adviser to the Company




 THE ACQUISITION AND THE EQUITY TRANSFER AGREEMENT

 The Board of Directors of the Company is pleased to announce that on 23 November 2026 (after
 trading hours), the Purchaser, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, entered into the
 Equity Transfer Agreement with the Vendor, pursuant to which the Purchaser has conditionally agreed
 to acquire and the Vendor has conditionally agreed to sell the Sale Shares, representing 100% of the
 equity interest in the Target Company at the cash Consideration of RMB30,100,000 (equivalent to
 approximately HK$35,122,000), which shall be satisfied in cash.

 Upon Completion, the Target Company will become an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of the
 Company and the financial results of the Target Company will be consolidated into the financial
 statements of the Group.

 LISTING RULES IMPLICATIONS

 Since the highest applicable percentage ratio under Rule 14.07 of the Listing Rules in respect of the
 Acquisition exceeds 100%, the Acquisition constitutes a very substantial acquisition for the Company
 under the Listing Rules and is therefore subject to the reporting, announcement, circular and
 Shareholders’ approval requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.



                                                     —1—
  EGM

 The EGM will be convened to consider and, if thought fit, approve, among other things, the Equity
 Transfer Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereunder.

 To the best of the Directors’ knowledge, information and belief, having made all reasonable enquiries,
 as at the date of the Equity Transfer Agreement, no Shareholder has a material interest in the Equity
 Transfer Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereunder. As such, no Shareholder will be
 required to abstain from voting on the resolution(s) to be proposed at the EGM to approve the Equity
 Transfer Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereunder.

 GENERAL

 A circular containing, among others, (i) further details of the Equity Transfer Agreement and the
 transactions contemplated thereunder; (ii) the accountant’s report on the Target Company; (iii) the
 unaudited pro forma financial information of the Enlarged Group; (iv) the valuation report on 100% of
 the equity interest in the Target Company prepared by the Independent Valuer; (v) other information
 as required to be disclosed under the Listing Rules; and (vi) a notice convening the EGM, will be
 despatched to the Shareholders on or before 10 December 2026.

 Shareholders and potential investors of the Company should note that the Completion is subject
 to the fulfilment of the Conditions Precedent under the Equity Transfer Agreement. As the
 Acquisition may or may not proceed, Shareholders and potential investors of the Company are
 reminded to exercise caution when dealing in the securities of the Company.


INTRODUCTION

On 23 November 2026 (after trading hours), the Purchaser and the Vendor entered into the Equity
Transfer Agreement, pursuant to which the Purchaser has conditionally agreed to acquire and the Vendor
has conditionally agreed to sell the entire equity interest of the Target Company at the cash
Consideration of RMB30,100,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$35,122,000).

THE EQUITY TRANSFER AGREEMENT

The principal terms of the Equity Transfer Agreement are summarised below.

Date                    23 November 2026 (after trading hours)

Parties                 (i)                                    , an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of
                              the Company, as purchaser; and




                                                —2—
                          (ii)   the Vendor, as vendor.

Subject matter           100% of the equity interest in the Target Company.

                         Upon Completion, the Target Company will become an indirect wholly-owned
                         subsidiary of the Company and the financial results of the Target Company will
                         be consolidated into the financial statements of the Group.

The Consideration

The Consideration is RMB30,100,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$35,122,000), which shall be
paid by the Purchaser to the Vendor in cash in the following manner:

(i)    as to RMB3,010,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$3,512,200), representing 10% of the
       Consideration, within one month after the date of the Equity Transfer Agreement (or such later
       date as the parties may mutually agree); and

(ii)   as to RMB27,090,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$31,609,800), representing the remaining
       90% of the Consideration, within one month after the Completion Date (or such later date as the
       parties may mutually agree).

The Consideration will be funded by the Group’s internal resources.

Profit guarantee

Pursuant to the Equity Transfer Agreement, the Vendor has guaranteed to the Purchaser that the net
profit after tax of the Target Company for each of the two financial years ending 31 December 2026 and
2027 will not be less than RMB7,000,000 and RMB9,100,000 respectively (the “Guaranteed Profit”).
The Purchaser will procure the auditors of the Group to issue the audited financial statements of the
Target Company within three months after the end of the 2026 and 2027 financial years. If the audited
net profit after tax of the Target Company for any of the 2026 and/or 2027 financial years is less than
the Guaranteed Profit, the Vendor shall pay the shortfall to the Purchaser in cash on a dollar-for-dollar
basis within 30 days after the issuance of such audited financial statements.

Conditions Precedent

Completion is conditional upon the fulfillment of the following Conditions Precedent:

(i)    the Purchaser having completed its due diligence on the Target Company and being satisfied with
       the results thereof;




                                                 —3—
 (ii)   all authorisations, consents, approvals, waivers, filings, registrations and permits from the relevant
       governmental authorities, regulatory authorities or other third parties required under applicable
       laws and regulations for the signing and performance of the Equity Transfer Agreement having
       been obtained;

(iii) the Final Valuation prepared and issued by the Independent Valuer, being not less than RMB30.7
      million;

(iv) the Equity Transfer Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereunder having been approved
     by the Shareholders at the EGM in accordance with the Listing Rules; and

(v)    the Acquisition is not regarded as a reverse takeover under the Listing Rules.

The Purchaser may at its discretion waive any of the Conditions Precedent, save for the conditions set
out in paragraphs (iv) and (v) above. If any of the Conditions Precedent is not satisfied or waived on or
before the Long Stop Date or such other date as the Purchaser and the Vendor may agree in writing,
either party may terminate the Equity Transfer Agreement by written notice to the other, whereupon the
Vendor shall return to the Purchaser all Consideration already paid (if any) within 14 days, and all rights
and obligations of the parties under the Equity Transfer Agreement shall cease, save in respect of any
antecedent breach.

As at the date of this announcement, none of the Conditions Precedent has been satisfied or waived.

Completion

Within 7 days after the fulfillment or waiver (as the case may be) of all the Conditions Precedent, the
parties shall sign and submit the documents required for the registration of change of shareholder in
respect of the Sale Shares. Completion shall take place upon completion of such change of registration,
whereupon the Purchaser will be registered as the legal holder of 100% of the equity interest in the
Target Company. If Completion does not take place within 30 days after the fulfillment or waiver (as the
case may be) of all the Conditions Precedent (or such other date as the parties may agree in writing)
without fault of either party, any party may terminate the Equity Transfer Agreement by written notice,
whereupon the Vendor shall return to the Purchaser all Consideration already paid (if any) within 14
days, and all rights and obligations of the parties under the Equity Transfer Agreement shall cease, save
in respect of any antecedent breach.

Retention of the management of the Target Company

Pursuant to the Equity Transfer Agreement, subject to the relevant PRC laws, the Vendor undertakes to
procure that the existing core technical and management team of the Target Company continues to serve
the Target Company for three years after the Completion. The biographical details of the core technical
and management team of the Target Company are set out below.




                                                   —4—
 Mr. Zhang Xiaoqing              , the executive director and legal representative of the Target Company,
is primarily responsible for overall corporate management, business development and daily operations of
the Target Company. Mr. Zhang has more than 20 years of experience in the electronic technology
industry. From 2005 to 2021, Mr. Zhang served as the chairman in Beijing Xingyuanda Technology Co.
Ltd.*                                , a PRC company engaged in, among others, satellite navigation and
location services, intelligent transportation and management businesses. Mr. Zhang obtained a
bachelor’s degree from Nanjing University                .

Dr. Zheng Qinfen              , the chief artificial intelligence scientist of the Target Company since 2022,
is primarily responsible for leading the core AI visual technology architecture and algorithm research
and development of the Target Company. Dr. Zheng has approximately 30 years of research and
development experience in artificial intelligence computer vision and image analysis, covering image
and video analytics, automatic target detection and recognition, human recognition and gait analysis, 3D
reconstruction and multi-sensor fusion. He has published over 70 academic papers in international
journals and holds a number of US invention patents. Prior to joining the Target Company, Dr. Zheng
was selected as an expert under the Shanghai “Thousand Talents Plan”                               ) in 2015.
Since joining the Target Company, Dr. Zheng has led the development of the Target Company’s
industrial AI visual algorithms and analytical models for operating condition recognition of dust removal
systems, visual monitoring of flue gas and dust concentration, and intelligent fault diagnosis of
industrial equipment. Dr. Zheng obtained a bachelor’s degree and a master’s degree in electronic
engineering from the University of Science and Technology of China                                      and a
doctoral degree in electrical engineering from the University of Southern California in the United States.

Dr. Zhou Yang           , the chief engineer of AI system technical support and research and development
of the Target Company since July 2019, is primarily responsible for overall AI system research and

              DISCLOSEABLE AND CONNECTED TRANSACTION
             ENTERING INTO THE COOPERATION AGREEMENT

 THE COOPERATION AGREEMENT

 On 23 November 2026 (after trading hours), Ricktake Development, an indirect wholly-
 owned subsidiary of the Company, entered into the Cooperation Agreement with Mr.
 Berg, the chairman of the Board, an executive Director and a substantial Shareholder,
 pursuant to which Ricktake Development and Mr. Berg agreed to cooperate on the
 development of the Property owned by Mr. Berg, with Ricktake Development committing
 the Investment Fund of AED4,150,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$8,717,490).

 LISTING RULES IMPLICATIONS

 As at the date of this announcement, Mr. Berg is the chairman of the Board, an executive
 Director and a substantial Shareholder who is deemed to be interested in 37,100,000
 Shares, representing approximately 25.76% of the total number of issued Shares of the
 Company and thus is a connected person of the Company under Rule 14A.07 of the
 Listing Rules. The entering into the Cooperation Agreement and the transactions
 contemplated thereunder therefore constitute a connected transaction of the Company
 under Chapter 14A of the Listing Rules.

 Since the highest applicable percentage ratio (as defined in the Listing Rules) in respect
 of the Cooperation Agreement exceeds 5% but is less than 25%, the entering into the
 Cooperation Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereunder constitute a
 discloseable transaction of the Company and are subject to the reporting and
 announcement requirements under Chapter 14 of the Listing Rules.

 As the highest applicable percentage ratio in respect of the Cooperation Agreement
 exceeds 5% but is less than 25% and the amount of the Investment Fund is less than
 HK$10,000,000, the entering into the Cooperation Agreement is subject to the reporting
 and announcement requirements, but is exempt from the circular, independent financial
 advice and independent Shareholders’ approval requirements under Chapter 14A of the
 Listing Rules.

 THE COOPERATION AGREEMENT

On 23 November 2026 (after trading hours), Ricktake Development, an indirect wholly-
owned subsidiary of the Company, entered into the Cooperation Agreement with Mr. Berg,
the chairman of the Board, an executive Director and a substantial Shareholder, pursuant to
which Ricktake Development and Mr. Berg agreed to cooperate on the development of the
Property owned by Mr. Berg, with Ricktake Development committing the Investment Fund
of AED4,150,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$8,717,490).

The principal terms of the Cooperation Agreement are set out as follows:

Date

23 November 2026

Parties

(1) Ricktake Development, as an investor; and

(2) Mr. Berg, as the owner of the Property.

Mr. Berg is the chairman of the Board, an executive Director and a substantial Shareholder
interested in approximately 25.76% of the total issued Shares.

The Property

The Property is a luxury villa under development, located at Pearl Jumeirah, Dubai, United
Arab Emirates.

Details of the Property are set out in the section headed ‘‘Information on the Property’’ in
this announcement.

Business Cooperation

Ricktake Development shall provide the Investment Fund for the development of the
Property, with the objective of facilitating the development, construction, marketing and sale
of the Property and generating returns through the sales proceeds derived therefrom.

Mr. Berg shall be responsible for project management and development, obtaining necessary
permits, maintaining the structural integrity of the Property and overseeing all sales and
marketing activities related to the Property.

Investment Fund

The Investment Fund of AED4,150,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$8,717,490) was
agreed after arm’s length negotiations between the Parties with reference to the estimated
current value of the Property (‘‘Estimated Current Value’’) of approximately AED58.78
million (equivalent to approximately HK$123.47 million), being the net value derived from
the estimated selling price (‘‘Estimated Selling Price’’) of the Property after deducting the
estimated costs to be incurred in completing the sale of the Property. The Investment Fund
represents approximately 7.06% of the Estimated Current Value.


                                            –2–
 The Investment Fund shall be transferred to the designated bank account of Mr. Berg within
seven (7) days of signing the Cooperation Agreement.

The Estimated Selling Price was amounted to approximately AED82.39 million (equivalent
to approximately HK$173.07 million) determined with reference to publicly available
indicative selling prices for villas in Pearl Jumeirah, Dubai, United Arab Emirates for the
last two years published on Bayut, the United Arab Emirates’ largest and leading online real
estate and property classifieds portal, headquartered in Dubai, as well as the location and
size of the Property.

Profit Sharing

Ricktake Development shall be entitled to share 7.06% of Net Profit.

The net profit (‘‘Net Profit’’) shall be calculated as: gross sales proceeds minus all the
direct and indirect costs and taxes for developing, managing, sales and marketing for the
Property. Such deductible costs shall include, without limitation:

(i)   land costs, construction and development costs;

(ii) professional fees, consultancy fees, agency fees, and permit-related expenses;

(iii) sales commissions, marketing expenses, and promotional costs;

(iv) financing costs;

(v) administrative and management expenses directly attributable to the Property; and

(vi) all applicable taxes, duties, and governmental charges.

It is mutually agreed by the Parties that, if the Property remains unsold for 36 months from
the date of the Cooperation Agreement, Ricktake Development, at its sole discretion, shall
have the right to terminate the Cooperation Agreement by providing written notice to Mr.
Berg. Upon such termination, Mr. Berg shall, within thirty (30) days of receipt of the
termination notice, (a) repay the Investment Fund in full and (b) pay Ricktake Development
a guaranteed return (‘‘Guaranteed Return’’) of 10.0% per annum, calculated as simple
interest on the principal of the Investment Fund from the date of the Cooperation Agreement
until the date of payment.

title: VOLUNTARY ANNOUNCEMENT STRATEGIC PARTNER INDUSTRIAL BANK HONG KONG BRANCH JOINS ENSEMBLE TX
text:

howsoever arising from or in reliance upon the whole or any part of the contents of this
announcement.




           International Business Digital Technology Limited

                      (Incorporated in the Cayman Islands with limited liability)
                                       (Stock Code: 1782)

                           VOLUNTARY ANNOUNCEMENT

    STRATEGIC PARTNER INDUSTRIAL BANK HONG KONG BRANCH
                     JOINS ENSEMBLETX

This announcement is made by International Business Digital Technology Limited (the
‘‘Company’’, together with its subsidiaries, collectively referred to as the ‘‘Group’’) on a
voluntary basis to provide the shareholders (‘‘Shareholders’’) and potential investors of the
Company with the latest update on the Group’s business development.

The board (the ‘‘Board’’) of directors (the ‘‘Directors’’) of the Company is pleased to
announce that on 2 November 2026, Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. Hong Kong Branch
(‘‘Industrial Bank Hong Kong Branch’’), a strategic partner of the Company, joined
EnsembleTX, the pilot phase of Project Ensemble initiated by the Hong Kong Monetary
Authority (the ‘‘HKMA’’), as a participating bank for tokenised deposits, and successfully
implemented interbank transactions of tokenised deposits, achieving full-process end-to-end
verification. This marks significant progress in the application of tokenisation technology by
Industrial Bank Hong Kong Branch and provides valuable practical experience for promoting
the interoperability of Hong Kong’s tokenisation market infrastructure.

EnsembleTX serves as an experimental platform driven by the HKMA to bridge traditional
finance with digital finance. In 2026, the project has been further upgraded to support 24/7
interbank settlement through tokenised central bank money. With the launch of the new
capability, Ensemble TX will further facilitate the scaling of transactions and the exploration
of more impactful tokenisation use cases which will deliver tangible benefits and support the
development of a sustainable tokenisation market.




                                                –1–
 During this pilot phase, the Group has worked in close collaboration with Industrial Bank
Hong Kong Branch, utilising the Group’s self-developed token issuance and management
system to jointly promote the research, development, and technical integration of tokenised
asset issuance and technology systems and to provide technical and system support for
Industrial Bank Hong Kong Branch’s relevant digital asset token issuance and management
business. Moving forward, Industrial Bank Hong Kong Branch will work closely with
regulatory authorities and collaborate with the Company to continuously explore innovations
in tokenisation technology, expand multi-scenario applications, align with Hong Kong’s
‘‘FinTech 2030’’ strategy, and actively integrate into the construction of Hong Kong’s
tokenisation ecosystem.

VIEWS OF THE BOARD

The Board considers that, with the gradual implementation of tokenised settlement
capabilities in the banking sector and the continuous expansion of application scenarios
such as tokenised funds, money market instruments, and cross-border interoperability, the
digital finance market is embracing long-term development opportunities, and that this
collaboration represents a practical initiative of the Group’s participation in financial
infrastructure construction, which will help advance the Group’s business development in
international digital finance and tokenised asset-related fields, and is in the overall interests
of the Company and the Shareholders.

WARNING STATEMENT

Shareholders and potential investors of the Company should note that there remain
uncertainties regarding the development, launch, and commercial application of the
abovementioned tokenised asset issuance system.

The Company will make further announcement(s) as and when appropriate or in
accordance with the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock Exchange
of Hong Kong Limited.

Shareholders and potential investors of the Company are advised to exercise caution
when dealing in the securities of the Company.

                                                    By order of the Board
                                     International Business Digital Technology Limited
                                                        Shi Zhimin
                                   Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director

Hong Kong, 23 November 2026

As at the date of this announcement, the Board comprises Mr. Shi Zhimin as executive
Director; Mr. Guan Haiqing as non-executive Director; and Mr. Yang Min, Mr. Hu Jianjun
and Ms. Ru Tingting as independent non-executive Directors.

 INJECTION INTO THE TARGET COMPANY

 in relation to the Possible Capital Injection.

 GENERAL

 The Possible Capital Injection, if it materialises, may constitute a notifiable transaction for the Company

 Injection, the Company will make further announcement(s) in accordance with the Listing Rules as

the Company or its wholly owned subsidiary will be interested in not less than 51% of the enlarged
registered capital of the Target Company and obtain control over the Target Company.

The specific terms of the Possible Capital Injection, including the transaction structure, the amount of
capital injection, the proportion of equity interest and the consideration, shall be subject to a formal
capital injection agreement to be entered into by the parties to the MOU.

Consideration

The consideration for the Possible Capital Injection will be determined with reference to a valuation
report to be prepared by an independent professional valuer to be engaged by the Company, with the
final terms to be negotiated by the parties to the MOU.

Due diligence

financial, tax and technical due diligence on the Target Company, and the TC Shareholders and the
Target Company shall provide full cooperation. The Company shall complete the due diligence within
60 days from the date of the MOU, which may be extended in writing by the parties to the MOU.




                                                  –2–

An exclusivity period shall commence from the date of signing of the MOU and continue for a period
of six months, or such later date as may be agreed in writing by the parties to the MOU. During the
exclusivity period, the TC Shareholders and the Target Company shall not approach, negotiate, provide
information to or enter into any documents with any third party in relation to the transfer of equity
interests, capital increase, change of control or acquisition/disposal of material assets of the Target
Company.

The parties to the MOU shall enter into a formal capital injection agreement in relation to the Possible
Capital Injection before the expiry of the exclusivity period.

Non-binding effect

Save for the provisions in relation to exclusivity, confidentiality, costs, legal effect, and governing law
and dispute resolution, the MOU is not legally binding on the parties to the MOU.

JV Company, which Sino Brighter, Dongguan Huicheng, Hangzhou Yunyao and Hangzhou

the JV Company as registered capital.

years from the establishment of the JV Company.

funded by internal resources of the Group.

financial results of the JV Company will be consolidated into the financial statements of
the Company.




                                             2

appointed by Sino Brighter.

registered capital, spin-off, merger, dissolution, liquidation, change of corporate form and

Dividend Distribution

The JV Company shall, after setting off accumulated losses of previous years and allocating
to the statutory surplus reserve, distribute not less than 30% of the distributable profits of

Each of the JV Parties is entitled to the dividends declared by the JV Company for the

GENERAL AUTHORIZATION TO SUBSCRIBE FOR PRODUCTS

In order to enhance the efficiency of utilisation of the Group’s idle funds, on 20 November 2026, the
Board has resolved to grant a general authorization for the Group to deploy the idle funds for the
investments in the Products that may be issued from time to time by six designated Issuer Groups
each for an aggregate maximum amount of not more than RMB105 million (approximately HK$123
million) or equivalent amount in other currencies at any given time (i.e. the Maximum Investment
Cap) in accordance with the Investment Policy implemented by the Group which sets out, amongst
others, the categories and the risk levels of the Products which the Group may invest therein and the
Maximum Investment Cap for each Issuer Group’s Products. Such general authorization shall be
valid for one year, commencing from 20 November 2026 to 19 November 2027 (both dates
inclusive).

Investors of the Products

The potential investors of the Products may include any of the Company’s direct or indirect, wholly or
non-wholly owned subsidiaries with idle funds (each an “Investor Subsidiary”).


INVESTMENT POLICY

All potential investments by the Group in the Products will strictly adhere to and comply with the
investment policy as approved by the Board which includes the following principal investment terms
and parameters (“Investment Policy”):

Permissible Product Categories

1. Cash Management Products

The investment scope of the Products under this category includes: interbank negotiable certificates of
deposit, bond repurchase agreements, central bank bills and policy bank bonds.

Liquidity*of the Products under this category: no fixed tenor and redemption is generally permissible
by immediate notice or within 1 to 2 working days.

*Note:
Liquidity represents the time required for the redemption and/or tenor of the Product.

2. Fixed-income Products

The investment scope of the Products under this category includes: treasury bonds, financial bonds,
corporate bonds, interbank negotiable certificates of deposit, non-standard debt, equity assets.
                                                  2
 Liquidity of the Products under this category: tenor ranges from 7 days to 12 months. In general, early
redemption of these Products will not be possible prior to the maturity date.

3. Structured Deposits

Structured deposits are deposits raised by commercial banks embedded in financial derivatives, which
are linked to fluctuations in underlying market assets including but not limited to interest rates, foreign
exchange rates, indices or credit rating of an entity. Structured deposits enable depositors to obtain
relevant returns while taking certain risks.

Liquidity of the Products under this category: tenor ranges from 7 days to 12 months. In general, early
redemption of these Products will not be possible prior to the maturity date.

Risk Level of the Products: Low to Moderate Risk

Under the Investment Policy, the Group may only invest in low to moderate risk Products, being
Products with relatively stable expected income, low possibility of loss of principal amount, low to
moderate risk ratings according to the internal rating mechanism of the relevant Product issuers,
whose issuers and guarantors have sound financial backgrounds and good credit qualifications
(collectively, “Low/Moderate Risk Products”).

Maximum Investment Cap for investment in the Products of each Issuer Group

The Maximum Investment Cap for investments in the Products of each Issuer Group is RMB105
million (approximately HK$123 million) or equivalent amount in other currencies. The Maximum
Investment Cap was determined after taking into account the bank deposits balance and the
anticipated assets management needs based on the current business operation and financial condition
of the Group.

Expected annualized rate of return

There is no requirement on the maximum or minimum rate of return. However, given the nature of the
Low/Moderate Risk Products and having considered the prevailing interest rates and the historical
performance of the Products or comparable products issued by the relevant Issuer Groups, it is
expected that the annualized rate of return of the relevant Products will generally be not more than 4%
per annum.
